advisory.heading: When you select a technical noun
advisory.text: A Skills folder of the project is a folder from this table that the project has.
advisory.problem: In skills/writing/agent-instructions/references/agent-skills-spec.md, lines 11 and 73 use the multi-word technical noun "Skills folder", which is not in the glossary or in the base list of technical-terms.md, and the section defines it only locally.
advisory.correction: Use words from the base list, for example "A folder from this table that the project has is a Skills location of the project" is also not permitted, so write "Use a folder from this table that the project has." and in line 11 write "Select the folder of the project for the Skill first, as the section "When you select the Skills folder of the project" tells you."; or add a warning that recommends a glossary entry for "Skills folder", as "When a technical noun is not in the base list or in the glossary" in technical-terms.md tells you.

advisory.heading: When you select the text
advisory.text: Select the Skills folder of the project first, as the section "When you select the Skills folder of the project" tells you.
advisory.problem: In skills/writing/agent-instructions/references/agent-skills-spec.md line 11, the only condition is the heading "When you write the folder and the frontmatter", so an edit job that changes only the frontmatter of a Skill that has a folder also gets the step to select a Skills folder.
advisory.correction: "When you make the folder of a new Skill, first select the Skills folder of the project, as the section "When you select the Skills folder of the project" tells you."

advisory.heading: When you put the text in sections and lists
advisory.text: Tier 1: When the target platforms include Claude Code and Codex, use the Skills folder of the project.
advisory.problem: In skills/writing/agent-instructions/references/agent-skills-spec.md line 73, one paragraph gives a sequence of steps (find the target platforms, find the folders, use a folder or ask the user, add a warning), and the step "use the Skills folder of the project" comes before the step that handles 2 or more folders or no folder.
advisory.correction:
Write the steps as a numbered list after the table:
  "1. Before you select the Skills folder of the project, find the target platforms as `loading-rules.md` tells you.
  2. When the target platforms include Claude Code and Codex, find the folders from this table that the project has. A `.claude/` folder without a `skills/` folder is not a Skills folder.
  3. If the project has 1 of these folders, use that folder. If the project has 2 or more of these folders, or none of these folders, ask the user one time which folder to use.
  4. For each Skill that you write for these target platforms, add a warning that gives the platform that does not load the Skill."

advisory.heading: When you select the text
advisory.text: If the project has 2 or more of these folders, or none of these folders, ask the user one time which folder to use.
advisory.problem: In skills/writing/agent-instructions/references/agent-skills-spec.md line 73, the sentence gives no target-platform condition, so an agent with only Claude Code as target platform and both `.claude/skills/` and `.agents/skills/` in the project cannot know whether to ask the user.
advisory.correction: "When the target platforms include Claude Code and Codex, and the project has 2 or more of these folders or none of these folders, ask the user one time which folder to use."
